Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: A high-level project profile representing a major project entity, often displayed as a story.

avatarUrl.description: Base64 or URL of the project avatar.

Sub.title: Sub
Sub.description: A sub-location or sector within a Profile representing the actual workspace for material management.

profileId.description: Foreign key to the parent Profile.

StockEntry.title: Stock Entry
StockEntry.description: A record of material inventory currently available at a specific sub-location.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., m3, zak, kg).

RAPItem.title: RAP Item
RAPItem.description: Rencana Anggaran Perusahaan (Enterprise Budget Plan) item defining planned material usage.

totalOrdered.description: Accumulated quantity ordered against this budget item.

MaterialRequest.title: Material Request
MaterialRequest.description: A formal request for materials linked to a specific sub-location.

subId.description: The unique identifier for the Sub location.

recipient.description: Person who received the material at site.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: System-generated notification for real-time alerts across roles.

MainMaterial.title: Main Material
MainMaterial.description: Master material names available for SM to request.

profiles.description: Collection of all high-level project profiles.

subs/{subId}/stock.description: Nested material inventory records for a specific sub-location.

subs/{subId}/rapData.description: Budget plan items specific to a project's sub-location.

requests.description: Central collection for all material logistics workflows.

notifications.description: Broadcast and targeted alerts for dashboard users.
